name: Decathlon Run 2026
short_description: Decathlon Run 2026 is a half-marathon event on August 30, 2026, at SM Mall of Asia, Pasay, Philippines.
ai_summary: Decathlon Run 2026 is a half-marathon event scheduled for August 30, 2026, at SM Mall of Asia in Pasay, Philippines. Organized by Runrio under the Decathlon Run brand, the event offers three distance options: 21.1km, 10km, and 5km, with the half-marathon serving as the primary distance. Registration details have not yet been announced.
pros: Multiple distance options (21.1km, 10km, 5km) accommodate different fitness levels
Convenient, accessible venue at SM Mall of Asia, Pasay
Organized by Runrio, an established name behind the Decathlon Run brand
cons: Registration status is not yet announced, so sign-up details are unavailable
No pricing or race-day logistics information currently provided
research_highlights: This is billed as the Decathlon Philippines 9th Anniversary Run, expected to draw around 8,000 runners to the SM MOA Complex in Pasay.
Distances offered are 5KM, 10KM, and 21KM, all starting at Ocean Drive corner Seaside Blvd.
Gun start is early morning (3:00 AM GMT+8 listed for the event), with a course sweep by ambulance starting at 7:00 AM to pick up remaining participants.
Participants must start within 15 minutes of their category's flag-off time or be disqualified with no official result issued.
Registration is non-transferable and non-refundable; race kits must be claimed in advance as there is no on-site registration or kit claiming on race day.
research_watchouts: No on-site registration or race-day kit claiming is available, so plan to collect your kit during the scheduled pre-race claiming period.
Wheelchairs, bikes, skates, and strollers are not permitted on the course.
Baggage tents are provided but organizers state they are not liable for lost or damaged belongings.
Protests over results must be filed in writing within one hour of posting and require a ₱5,000 protest fee.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at Decathlon Run 2026?
faqs.answer: Decathlon Run 2026 offers three distance categories for participants to choose from: a 21.1km half-marathon, which serves as the primary distance for the event, along with 10km and 5km options. This range allows runners of different experience levels and training backgrounds to take part in the race.

faqs.question: Where is Decathlon Run 2026 taking place?
faqs.answer: The race will be held at SM Mall of Asia, located in Pasay, in the Philippines. This venue serves as the starting point and hub for the event, making it a notable landmark location for participants traveling to take part in the race.

faqs.question: When is Decathlon Run 2026 scheduled?
faqs.answer: Decathlon Run 2026 is scheduled to take place on August 30, 2026. This date marks the event day when runners across the 21.1km, 10km, and 5km distance categories will gather at SM Mall of Asia in Pasay, Philippines, to participate.

faqs.question: Is registration open for Decathlon Run 2026?
faqs.answer: As of now, the registration status for Decathlon Run 2026 has not yet been announced by the organizer, Runrio. Prospective participants interested in joining the half-marathon, 10km, or 5km races should watch for further updates regarding sign-up details and availability closer to the event date.
